notes.title: Visions of Mana is out today!
notes.content:
Visions of Mana is a brand new title in this series revolving around the sacred sword and mana. 
The protagonist Val and his childhood friend Hinna, the newly appointed Alm of Fire, set off on a journey to the Mana Tree. 

This game’s iconic vibrant and vast semi-open field contains adorable yet ferocious monsters, allowing you to enjoy swift three-dimensional battles using the power of the Elementals. 
Through adventures with friends met along the way, they start to see the truth about the world. 
Must we accept our fates? 
A new “Mana” tale begins here as a classic fantasy series returns to its roots.  

[b]Early purchase bonuses:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841609/b7c5fb8e41b5e9acf00c390fe7b323f8d47cd197.png[/img]
・“Guardian Garment” outfit for Val.
・“Starter Pack”: A set of items that can be used to boost the amount of experience points and lucre earned for a fixed time.
*These items will be gifted to customers who purchase the game before 16:59 BST / 08:59 PDT on September 30th 2024

[h3]Visions of Mana Demo is available now![/h3]
Experience a section of the story, battles and exploration.
*Some content differs from the release version of the game.

notes.title: A message from Secret of Mana producer Masaru Oyamada
notes.content:
This is Secret of Mana Producer Masaru Oyamada.

I would like to confirm that we released an update for the Steam version of the game.

As previously announced, this update deals with several issues affecting game progress as a priority.

It has been confirmed that applying this update will reduce the frequency with which application errors occur, but there are unfortunately still some occurrences as before. We are also looking into other issues reported that are not addressed in this patch. We will make suitable investigations and take everyone’s feedback into account in order to prepare for the next patch as soon as possible.

I must apologise sincerely for the continued inconvenience.

We will announce full details of the next patch as soon as they are finalised, so watch out for future updates.

Masaru Oyamada, Producer of Secret of Mana

===

[b]Version update (1.01) information[/b]

We have released a patch which allows the version update (1.01) for Secret of Mana. The update contents are as follows:

Update Contents:
[list]
[*]Fewer application errors.
[*]Fewer instances of characters suddenly appearing on a blacked-out background.
[*]Reduced frequency of corrupted character colors after a status ailment has worn off.
[*]Fewer instances of the screen appearing half in black.
[*]Characters will no longer be revived with 0 HP.
[*]Conversations in certain areas now end normally.
[*]Reduced frequency of characters not appearing properly in areas set above ground level.
[*]Enemies no longer become immobile when certain combinations of attacks and magic are used.
[*]Bow and arrow weapons now behave differently in battles with certain monsters.
[*]Adjustments to certain DLC wallpaper images.
[/list]

Added features:
[list]
[*]Guide text displayed for changing buttons on the ring command menu.
[*]Character icons for denoting the ring in use on the ring command menu.
[*]Item effects displayed on the ring command menu.
[/list]

We apologize for the troubles so far. We appreciate for your patience.

notes.title: The Secret of Mana 3D remake is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Last week we announced that the legendary Secret of Mana is getting a full 3D remake and being released on Steam on the 15th of February, 2018 (not long to go!) To add to that you’re now also able to pre-order the game; for pre-ordering you’ll receive special character costumes (Moogle Suit for Randi, Primm and Popoi, Tiger Two-Piece for Primm and Tiger Suit for Randi and Popoi) as well as a custom downloadable wallpaper!

If you want to know a little more about Secret of Mana, read on below!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30451857/91ebfdd719163fba6a7ef380cf4f596e1c52194a.jpg[/img]

Originally released in 1993 and widely regarded as one of the greatest RPGs of all time, Secret of Mana invites players on an action-packed adventure taking on the role Randi, along with his two companions, Primm and Popoi, as they battle a perilous empire to reclaim the magical power of Mana and bring the world back to order.
Whilst faithfully retelling the beloved story of Randi, Primm and Popoi, Secret of Mana will also include a host of new features and exciting updates for players to enjoy, including:

• Audio Updates – including a newly arranged musical score and voiced characters
• 3D Graphics - revamped visuals for the entire game; a vivid, Mana-filled world rebuilt in 3D for the first time
• Upgraded Gameplay – the original system has been reworked in an effort to realise a modern action-RPG with improved gameplay
• Dialog scenes added – several core scenes from the original story now newly visualized in-game

Whether you’ve played Secret of Mana before or not; we all hope you’re really looking forward to trying out this updated version of the legendary RPG!
